name: How long does it take to install a fire-bowl?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a fire-bowl?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a fire-bowl installation varies depending on the project's complexity, the type of fire-bowl, and existing site conditions. A standard, gas-fueled fire-bowl with readily available utilities can often be installed within 1 to 3 days. Projects requiring new gas line extensions, extensive landscaping modifications, or custom features may extend to a week or more. We provide a detailed timeline after the initial site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time typically ranges from 1 to 3 days for standard projects, but can be longer for complex custom designs or extensive utility work.
